title: Remove dead runtime decomposition (AGENT.Runtime stubs + DI)
description: P0 finding from 2026-07-11 audit (MSA-RT-006, council-upgraded): The Sprint 37+ runtime decomposition (6 interfaces + 6 stub implementations + AgentRuntime record + DI registrations) is completely unused by AgentBackgroundService. ABS receives all dependencies directly. Delete: AgentRuntime record, IRecoveryManager/IPlanningManager/IExecutionManager interfaces + stubs, and their DI registrations. Consolidate to only IIrentManager/IDashboardPublisher/IStateManager which have real value. This removes 12+ findings in one commit. Source: Data/Pages/Audits/codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council.md (P0-001)

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: **Council recalibration from internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11):** Severity downgraded from P0 to P2. The AgentRuntime decomposition dead code is architectural debt, not an active crash/security risk. However, the scope is larger than originally estimated — it includes AgentRuntime + DashboardPublisherImpl dead code + 6 unused manager interfaces. See TSK-0404 for the DashboardPublisherImpl component.
